title: Check that the ADR index matches each ADR's decision range and status
body: Outcome: a deterministic check fails when docs/adr/README.md misstates ADR 0014's decision range (it said D1–D24 while ADR 0014 held D1–D30; found by review prepass on PR #217) or an ADR's index status differs from its Status section. Proof: an observer red on a fixture with a stale range and green on main.
